# Pink Shakti

> India's 360° women's ecosystem helping women build skills, find community, showcase their work, meet clients and sell through events, mentorship and Sakhi Bazaar.

Pink Shakti is an initiative of ZCAD Group, founded by Manish Patel and based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It works across 8 pillars: Health & Wellness, Leadership & Power, Wealth & Entrepreneurship, Education & Future, Rights, Safety & Justice, Society, Culture & Environment, Media & Global Connect, and Inspiration & Recognition.

Key facts: 1,200+ founders and changemakers at the first Women Leadership Summit; 50,000+ women reached through events and programmes; 8 cities reached; PINK SHAKTI Awards partnerships across 5 countries.

Membership (Pink Saathi): Aarambh is free for life. Paid plans Udaan, Pragati and Shikhar add skill workshops, stage pitch time, stall discounts, mentorship, client introductions and product listings on Sakhi Bazaar.
